react-infolabel.notes: BATCH-2 CONVERTED 2026-07-27 (VR NOT RUN - brief forbade storybook rebuild, so not yet 'validated'). Converted: InfoButton.module.css (root slot, fui.components.l1) + InfoLabel.module.css (label/infoButton slots, fui.components.l2 - InfoLabel styles NOTHING of its own; both styled slots are other components' hook output) + 2 clsx hooks. WHITELISTED @griffel/react IMPORT: InfoButton's `info` slot (PopoverSurface) stays on makeStyles/mergeClasses deliberately. PopoverSurface is unconverted and Griffel injects UNLAYERED, so a layered .info class would LOSE to its own typographyStyles.body1 and every small/medium popover would render at fontSizeBase300 instead of caption1's fontSizeBase200 - the reverse of the ToggleButton-over-Button case where unlayered winning is correct. Converts with react-popover. Data-attributes added: data-size + data-open (InfoButton root), data-size (InfoLabel root). Inversion 1 (Griffel source): `selected` declared 2nd but applied 4th and collides with `highContrast` on key B7iucu3 (forced-colors color CanvasText vs Canvas) -> selected block written after highContrast. Inversion 2 (introduced by the l2 altitude, corrected in-module): InfoLabel's `color: inherit` on the label would outrank react-label's `@media(forced-colors){color:GrayText}`, which Griffel's `m`-bucket order had winning -> that rule is restated inside InfoLabel's .label block. Block order follows Griffel BUCKET order (d/f/i/h/m), not plain argument order, because :where() flattening removes the specificity that separated :hover from base. FIRST consumer of the shared fui-focus-outline utility (react-tailwind-theme flagged it unexercised): validated 17/17 against this package's compiled AOT in Chromium - @apply does inline its nested &::after and @media blocks. Zero value-level RTL flips (all four [ltr,rtl] atomic pairs carry identical values). Tests 40/40, 0 snapshots (package has none). Build green; dist/styles.css 5507B starts with the canonical @layer statement; zero dangling .module.css specifiers; InfoLabel's styles.raw.js deleted, InfoButton's retained with its Griffel slice. Lint + type-check clean (tsconfig.spec.json and tsconfig.cy.json needed the `static-assets` type - react-link/react-list precedent - because both test programs import useInfoButtonStyles.styles directly). Probes in .scratch/infolabel: fidelity+matrix (54 declarations, 28 render cases) and Chromium computed-style (64 assertions incl. the VR blind spots: hover-over-OPEN, forced-colors x open, disabled InfoLabel in HC, LTR+RTL). Icon-swap rules must be UNLAYERED (react-icons atomics are unlayered) — see D2 amendment 5.

react-popover.notes: BATCH-4 CONVERTED 2026-07-28 (VR NOT RUN - brief forbade a storybook rebuild). Converted: PopoverSurface.module.css (root + arrow, all fui.components.l1) + the clsx hook. Popover and PopoverTrigger have NO styles hook and render no DOM of their own, so PopoverSurface is the only marker-bearing component; both opt out of `component-has-group-marker` per component alongside the DOM-dependent defaults they already disabled. popoverSurfaceClassNames narrowed to { root: 'group/fui-popover-surface' } (D16.1/D16.5); `arrowHeights` unchanged (it is a JS number map read by usePopover's mergeArrowOffset, not a class). Data attributes added: data-size (small|medium|large) + data-inline (presence) on the root. No mirrors: nothing on a descendant needs to read root state - the arrow gets its geometry class directly from the hook. ARROW / react-positioning seam: `createArrowStyles({ arrowHeight: undefined })` + `createArrowHeightStyles(6|8)` were TRANSCRIBED into the module (identical treatment to react-tooltip, which converted the same factory first). react-positioning keeps exporting both for apps/vr-tests-react-components/src/stories/Positioning/utils.tsx. The rules stay LAYERED (l1), not unlayered: react-positioning injects no CSS for the arrow - it only writes the data-popper-placement ATTRIBUTE from JS - so D2 amendment 5 does not apply. `--fui-positioning-arrow-height/offset` stay literal px (8.484/-4.242, 11.312/-5.656) because usePopover.ts does the matching offset arithmetic in JS pixels; rescaling through --base-scale would desync CSS from JS at a non-default root font size. Griffel `:global([data-popper-placement^="x"])` compiled to a DESCENDANT selector; reproduced as `:where(:global([data-popper-placement^='x'])) &` (0-1-0 instead of Griffel 0-2-0 - inert, the four blocks are mutually exclusive and nothing else sets those properties). ZERO inversions: mergeClasses argument order and source-declaration order agree throughout. ZERO [ltr,rtl] atomic pairs in the compiled AOT, so no @variant rtl block; the four @noflip declarations (2x border-bottom-left-radius, transform:rotate, left/right offsets) stay PHYSICAL. Shorthands: `border-radius` and `border: 1px solid ...` kept as compiled shorthands (react-tooltip precedent) - no rule in the module sets any of their longhands, so no Griffel priority machinery survives to get wrong. `padding: 12/16/20px` -> p-horizontal-m/-l/-xl (px literals landing exactly on spacing steps M/L/XL). `filter: drop-shadow(...)` px stay literal: it is a hand-rolled stand-in for the --shadow16 TOKEN, and tokens never ride --base-scale. Zero fui-Icon-* / :global(.fui-*) hits in this package; the only :global() is the data-popper-placement attribute on the component OWN root. Tests 63/63, 1 snapshot updated (fui-PopoverSurface -> group/fui-popover-surface, + data-size="medium"), which is the only expected shape. Build green; dist/styles.css 3708 B starting with the canonical @layer statement; zero .fui-[A-Z] statics; 6 fuicm-* idents. Lint + type-check clean (tsconfig.spec.json and tsconfig.cy.json needed the `static-assets` type). jest.config.js: @griffel/jest-serializer DROPPED for cssModules.snapshotSerializer (react-tooltip precedent) - no src file imports @griffel/react any more, the package renders no react-icons glyphs, and nothing it mounts emits Griffel atomics. Probes in .scratch/popover: fidelity.js compares all 47 compiled Griffel declarations across 10 slices against dist/styles.css - ALL MATCH; a throwaway render-matrix test covered 36 cases (size x appearance x inline x withArrow), asserting classList[0] is always the hashed module class, exactly one group marker, consumer className last, and correct data-* / arrow geometry class. OPEN SEAM (reported, not edited): packages/charts/react-charts/library/src/components/HeatMapChart/HeatMapChart.test.tsx:317,320,326,329 still query `.fui-PopoverSurface` - 1 test now fails and is NOT -u-regenerable (needs fuiSelector(popoverSurfaceClassNames.root) or a role/attribute selector). 8 charts snapshot files carry the static and need -u: DonutChart, GanttChart, GaugeChart, GroupedVerticalBarChart, LineChart, SankeyChart, VerticalBarChart, VerticalStackedBarChart. NOTE on the measured baseline: react-charts:test was ALREADY red in this working tree when the popover conversion started, but from a CONCURRENT sibling batch-4 change (react-overflow, uncommitted here: 14 charts snapshot files still say fui-Overflow while react-overflow now emits group/fui-overflow), not from anything on the committed branch - so the charts snapshot sweep has to cover both conversions at once. OPEN SEAM (reported, not edited): react-infolabel`s whitelisted @griffel/react import (useInfoButtonStyles.styles.ts `info` slot) is now UNBLOCKED - PopoverSurface is layered, so a fui.components.l2 `.info` module class would win. Behaviour-neutral either way (Griffel unlayered still beats the layer today), so it is a cleanup, not a fix.
